rules.json: UTF-8, exactly one JSON object, duplicate keys and trailing content rejected
rules.corpus: frozen manifest hash, development split, exactly 40 unique cases
rules.report: matching corpus hash, declared runtime/contract/order, no locked or final IDs
rules.C0: current seven-field schema and request-scoped IDs/evidence
rules.C1: typed bounded ordinal arrays mapped through the current request
rules.C2: SUPPORTED, NOT_SUPPORTED, or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE exactly once per candidate; evidence derived in fact order
rules.T1: selection-only bounded ordinals plus limitations; evidence derived in fact order
rules.T2: prose and limitations only; frozen expected selections are preserved for scoring
rules.invariance: mapped cause, check, and evidence arrays must match across opposite orders
rules.heuristics: deterministic lexical/reference checks only; no model-based judgment
